info.name: Run inference against a deployed model.

params.name: model_name
params.description: The model name segment of the auto-generated inference URL.

items.docs: Sends an inference request to a deployed model's auto-generated endpoint. The request body uses the KServe v2 inputs[] structure (name, shape, datatype, data). This path is served from the per-deployment inference host, not from api.inferless.com.
